note: Gate scenarios for Rust / C / C++ samples. Rust: features_on / features_off ('pkg/feature' or 'feature'), cargo_features ('default' | 'none' | list: the exact enabled set), cfg_true / cfg_false (cfg atoms such as unix, target_os="linux"). C/C++: defines_on (NAME or NAME=VALUE) / defines_off (NAME). Code under a #[cfg]/#if that is false in the scenario is labelled gated. Beta: the first scenario is used.

scenarios.name: minimal_build
scenarios.description: kv-core built without its default 'fs' feature and without 'compression'; C/C++ samples built without RB_THREADSAFE and without BUS_WITH_METRICS.
